“Shirou. Does your wound no longer hurt?”

“…I see. Then I am relieved.”

“……………………”

It has been an hour since we returned. We have spent it like this, exchanging no words, each conscious of the others.

We have no room to rejoice at Tohsaka's safety, much less celebrate our reunion.

No wonder we have so little to say.

pages.en:
Looking back, it has only been about ten days.

Ten days of being swept from one event to the next, without even the leisure to think back on the day before.

…But not all of it was painful.

Now, looking back, those ten days have become irreplaceable memories.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Looking back, it was only a course of about ten days.
I never had time to think back about what happened the day before, and I was too busy with all the events that came up one after another.
…But they weren’t just painful events.
Looking back at it, these past ten days are precious memories that can’t be replaced.

None of us can say it aloud because none of us wants everything that has brought us this far to end like this.

Perhaps out of concern for me, Tohsaka leaves me a way out.

But I have already chosen my answer too.

We cannot leave Gilgamesh unchecked.

Instinct tells me that the Holy Grail he means to use is something that must not be allowed to exist.

But more than any of that, I have another reason not to retreat.

セイバーにはアイツの足止めをしてもらって、その隙にわたしたちで聖杯を壊す……っていうのが理想でしょうね」
pages.en:
“True. But knowing exactly where he'll be also helps us.

“He's dangerous, but stopping the Grail's summoning comes first.

“Ideally, Saber will hold him there while the two of us destroy the Holy Grail.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yeah. But on the other hand, it’s easier on us because we know where he is.
He’s troublesome, but stopping the summoning of the Holy Grail takes priority.
It would be ideal if we can destroy the Holy Grail while Saber keeps him busy.”

pages.ja: 「待った。聖杯を壊すって、それはセイバーじゃないと出来ないんじゃないのか？ 俺たちじゃ聖杯には触れないんだろ」
pages.jaRuby: 「待った。聖杯を壊すって、それはセイバーじゃないと出来ないんじゃないのか？ 俺たちじゃ聖杯には触れないんだろ」
pages.en: “Wait. Destroy the Grail? Isn't that something only Saber can do? I thought we couldn't even touch it.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Hold on. Isn’t Saber the only one who can destroy the Holy Grail? We can’t touch it, right?”

pages.ja:
「そうね、わたしたちに呼び出された聖杯を壊す事はできない。けど、その前に聖杯の器を壊す事はできる。
正確には聖杯が発動する前に停止させるって事だけど」
pages.jaRuby:
「そうね、わたしたちに呼び出された聖杯を壊す事はできない。けど、その前に聖杯の器を壊す事はできる。
正確には聖杯が発動する前に停止させるって事だけど」
pages.en:
“That's right. We can't destroy the Holy Grail after it has been summoned. But before that happens, we can destroy its vessel.

“Strictly speaking, we'd be shutting it down before it can activate.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Right. We can’t destroy the summoned Holy Grail. But we can destroy the vessel before it’s summoned.
To be more precise, we’re stopping the Holy Grail before it’s activated.”

pages.ja: 「む。聖杯を停止させるってどういう意味だ」
pages.jaRuby: 「む。聖杯を停止させるってどういう意味だ」
pages.en: “Hm. What do you mean, shutting it down?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Hm? What do you mean by stopping the Holy Grail?”

pages.ja:
「……。あんまり考えたくないんだけど、今までの話を総合すると、聖杯はイリヤスフィールの心臓でしょ。
けど、聖杯っていうのはイリヤスフィールの体……魔術回路とセットだと思う。
アイツはイリヤスフィールが聖杯になる事を嫌がって、核となる器官だけを引き抜いた」
pages.jaRuby:
「……。あんまり考えたくないんだけど、今までの話を総合すると、聖杯はイリヤスフィールの心臓でしょ。

pages.en:
“…I don't especially want to think about this, but if we put everything we've learned together, the Holy Grail is Illyasviel's heart.

“But I think the Grail was meant to function together with Illyasviel's body——with her Magic Circuits.

“He objected to Illyasviel herself becoming the Holy Grail, so he removed only the organ that would serve as its core.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I really don’t want to think about it, but from what I heard, the Holy Grail is Illyasviel’s heart, right?
But I think the Holy Grail is a set with Illyasviel’s body, her Magic Circuit.
He didn’t want Illyasviel to be the Holy Grail, so he pulled out the core of it, her heart.”

pages.ja:
「……と、するとね。
聖杯として機能させる為には、もう一度魔術師の体に埋め込まないといけない。残ったマスターはわたしとあと一人だけ。
わたしがここにいる以上、アイツが聖杯基盤に選ぶのは
」
pages.jaRuby:

」
pages.en:
“…And if that's true——

“to make it function as the Holy Grail, he has to implant it in a mage's body again. Only two Masters remain: me and one other.

“Since I'm here, the foundation he'll choose for the Grail has to be——”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……So.
He has to implant the heart into a magus’s body to activate it as the Holy Grail. There are only two remaining Masters: me, and one other.
Since I’m here, the one he will choose to be the foundation of the Holy Grail is
”

pages.ja: 「慎二って事か……！？ けど慎二には、その」
pages.jaRuby: 「慎二って事か……！？ けど慎二には、その」
pages.en: “Shinji…!? But Shinji doesn't have——”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Shinji…!? But Shinji, um…”

pages.ja:
「魔術回路がないって言うんでしょ。……きっとそんなの構わないのよ、アイツは。

pages.jaRuby:
「魔術回路がないって言うんでしょ。……きっとそんなの構わないのよ、アイツは。

pages.en:
“Magic Circuits, right? …I'm sure that doesn't matter to him.

“He wants to create an imperfect Grail, so it makes sense that he would implant it in an imperfect Master.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Doesn’t have a Magic Circuit, right? …I bet he doesn’t care.
He wants to make an incomplete Holy Grail, so I’m sure he’ll implant it into an incomplete Master.”

pages.ja:
「……血が絶えたっていっても、間桐の血族には遺伝的に魔術回路の跡があるし。
イリヤスフィールの心臓なんて、そんな核融合炉をつけられたら、閉じてた回路だって力ずくで開かれるわ」
pages.jaRuby:
「……血が絶えたっていっても、間桐の血族には遺伝的に魔術回路の跡があるし。

pages.en:
“…Even if the Matou line has failed, hereditary traces of Magic Circuits remain in the family.

“Attach something like Illyasviel's heart—a fusion reactor of a thing—and even sealed Circuits will be forced open.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Even if its bloodline is extinct, the Matou family has hereditary traces of Magic Circuits.
Illyasviel’s heart is like a nuclear fusion reactor. Even a closed circuit will be forced open if it’s implanted into him.”

pages.ja:
「
」

I don't know what becoming the Grail's foundation entails, but if there is still time to stop it, we have to.

“
”

I don’t know what it means to be the Holy Grail’s foundation, but, if possible, we’ll have to stop it.

pages.ja:
「ですが、それをギルガメッシュが許すとは思えない。

“But I cannot imagine Gilgamesh permitting that.

“Does stopping the Holy Grail not therefore require defeating Gilgamesh?”

“…Yeah. He's obviously protecting it. Until we deal with him, we can't even begin.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But I do not think Gilgamesh will allow that.
Does it not mean that stopping the Holy Grail is to defeat Gilgamesh?”
“…Yeah. It’s obvious that he’s protecting the Holy Grail, so we have to do something about him first.”

pages.ja:

だから
」

だから
」

So
”

Rin and Shirou will sneak into the Ryuudou Temple from the back while I do so.
The boundary field on the Ryuudou Temple is meaningless for you two.”

「そういう事。……セイバーには頑張ってもらうしかないんだけど、とにかくアイツの足止めをして。わたしたちも聖杯を止め次第、すぐに駆けつけるから」
「
待った。それは無茶だ。セイバーじゃアイツには敵わない。

pages.en:
“Exactly. …We'll have to ask a great deal of you, Saber, but hold him there as long as you can. The moment we've stopped the Holy Grail, we'll come to you.”

“——Wait. That's too reckless. Saber can't defeat him.

“I don't think she'll even be able to hold him.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Exactly. …You will need to give your absolute best, but just keep him busy. We’ll come help you as soon as we stop the Holy Grail.”
“
Hold on. That’s reckless. Saber won’t be a match for him.
She can’t keep him busy.”

pages.en:
“Huh? What's this, Shirou? You're awfully eager to take his side.”

“Indeed. He is certainly a formidable opponent, but if I devote myself to defense, I will not be easily defeated.

“Explain the basis for your conclusion, Shirou.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Huh? What? You seem to think pretty highly of him, Shirou.”
“True. He is a strong enemy, but I will not lose easily if I go into defense.
Please tell me what that opinion is based on.”

pages.ja:
「あ、いや、そういう意味じゃないんだ。俺が見たかぎり、アイツよりセイバーの方が強い。

pages.jaRuby:
「あ、いや、そういう意味じゃないんだ。俺が見たかぎり、アイツよりセイバーの方が強い。

pages.en:
“No, that's not what I meant. From what I saw, Saber is stronger than he is.

“I'm absolutely certain. I'd stake my life on it.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, that’s not what I meant. From what I see, Saber’s stronger than him.
I’m sure of it. I’ll bet on it too.”

pages.jaRuby: 「？ では、何故そのような事を言うのです」
pages.en: “? Then why would you say such a thing?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “…? Then why are you saying that?”

pages.ja:
「だから、英霊である限りアイツには勝てないんだ。

pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Because as long as she's a Heroic Spirit, she can't defeat him.

“…Look at it this way: if he possessed only the same Noble Phantasm as Saber, she would never lose. As swordsmen, there is no comparison between them.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You can’t beat him as long as you’re a heroic spirit.
…Yeah, Saber won’t lose if he only had the same Noble Phantasm as Saber. We don’t even need to compare the two’s skills as swordsmen.”

pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“But his strength isn't the strength of an individual. No matter how exceptional a soldier may be, he can't defeat war itself.

“That's the kind of Heroic Spirit he is. Unless you can meet him with a war of your own, you'll be swallowed whole.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But his power isn’t power as an ‘individual’. A soldier can’t beat war itself no matter how strong he is, right?
He’s a heroic spirit of that kind. You’ll be defeated unless you’re a ‘war’ just like him.”

pages.jaRuby: 「……？……つまり、シロウは私と彼とでは相性が悪い、と言っているのですね？」
pages.en: “…?…In other words, Shirou, you believe he and I are a poor match?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “……? …So you are telling me that my attributes are not fit to fight him?”

pages.en:
“Yeah, exactly. So, Tohsaka, we can't send Saber against him without a plan. Unless we find some kind of opening, she has no chance.”

“Hmph… I know that without you telling me.

“That's why I'm saying we need to think of one now.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yeah. Tohsaka, we can’t let Saber fight him without a plan. There’s no way she can win unless we have some sort of a countermeasure.”
“Hey… I know that already.
That’s why we’re going to think about it now.”

pages.ja: 「ふむ。では、凛には策があるのですね？」
pages.jaRuby: 「ふむ。では、凛には策があるのですね？」
pages.en: “I see. Then you have some strategy in mind, Rin?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Hm. Then you have a plan, Rin?”

」

」
pages.en:
“Oh, please. You think a convenient answer is simply going to fall into my lap?

“Shirou is right: that man's Noble Phantasm is a war.

“And wars are decided by how much force each side can marshal. What matters isn't how skillfully you wield a weapon, but whether you can bring the same force to bear against——”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hey now. I won’t conveniently come up with an idea in a flash.
His Noble Phantasm is a war, like Shirou said.
The outcome of a war is decided by how much force you have, right? It’s not how well you can handle the weapon. It’s how much force you can prepare
”

“…I see. That's why he treated you as his mortal enemy. Of course——if a Heroic Spirit has no Noble Phantasm of his own, then the original weapon can never have existed. Ah… wait. That means——”
pages.mirrorMoon:

“…I see. That’s why he treated you like an enemy. Since the heroic spirit doesn’t have his own Noble Phantasm, there is no original. Oh… wait. That means…”

pages.mirrorMoon:

“I-It’s nothing…! I’m going to think, so just talk it over with just the two of you…!”

セイバーと二人、顔を見合わせる。

pages.jaRuby:

I can use my Noble Phantasm with her support. I believe there is a chance of beating him before he can use his Noble Phantasm.”

“No. Invisible Air is no more than a sheath.

“With Rin's permission, I can wield my own holy sword.

“It was that same blade with which I destroyed the Holy Grail in the previous war.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Your Noble Phantasm…? Not Invisible Air?”
